title: Drake - Nothing Was The Same Album Cover
coreRelationships: The man's profile is sharply contrasted against the soft, out-of-focus sky.
The bright blue of the sky provides a vibrant backdrop for the warm skin tones.
The gold chain adds a metallic accent and texture against the smooth skin.
The clouds are subtly rendered, providing depth without distracting from the subject.
